children: authorized a share repurchase program of up to $1B through 2029 and unveiled new long-term financial targets at its investor day.

The Swiss sportswear maker is targeting high-teens annual net sales growth on a constant-currency basis, with sales reaching at least CHF 5.6B by 2029. It expects gross margin to remain at 65% or higher and adjusted EBITDA margin to reach at least 22%.
Adjusted EBITDA is expected to grow at a compound annual rate of more than 20% from 2026 through 2029. The buyback is On Holding
’s first and covers Class A ordinary shares through December 2029.

maintained its outlook for low-20% constant-currency sales growth and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 19.5% to 20%. It expects about 17% sales growth in constant-currency terms in the third quarter, along with up to $65M in tariff refunds.

The company said it expects to significantly exceed the 2026 financial targets set in 2023. Its growth strategy centers on its run, sneaker, and apparel businesses, with expansion into football and golf.

title: On Holding targets CHF 5.6B sales by 2029, authorizes $1B buyback
